style: who is speaking to whom, and what has just happened

candidates.angle: who is speaking to whom: Krishna warns Arjuna
candidates.evidence: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः पश्यति

angle_en: Action has many causes; the pure self is not the lone doer.

en.notice: Krishna calls the person who sees the pure self as the sole doer confused, blind to the five causes.
en.meaning: But one who sees only the pure self as the doer, even though these five causes are present, has not seen rightly; such a confused mind does not understand.

hi.meaning: परन्तु ऐसे पाँच हेतुओंके होनेपर भी जो उस कर्मोंके विषयमें केवल शुद्ध आत्माको कर्ता मानता है, वह दुर्मति ठीक नहीं समझता क्योंकि उसकी बुद्धि शुद्ध नहीं है ॥

en.body: But one who sees only the pure self as the doer, even though these five causes are present, has not seen rightly; such a confused mind does not understand. Krishna calls the person who sees the pure self as the sole doer confused, blind to the five causes. Next, Krishna continues.

hi.body: परन्तु ऐसे पाँच हेतुओंके होनेपर भी जो उस कर्मोंके विषयमें केवल शुद्ध आत्माको कर्ता मानता है, वह दुर्मति ठीक नहीं समझता क्योंकि उसकी बुद्धि शुद्ध नहीं है ॥ आगे श्रीकृष्ण कहते हैं।
